questions.question: The trailer hand valve should be used:

options.text: To test the trailer brakes.
To check the connection between the trailer and tractor.
To accelerate.

questions.correctAnswerText: To test the trailer brakes.
questions.explanation: The trailer hand valve is used only to test the trailer brakes. Do not use it while driving, as it can cause the vehicle to skid.

questions.question: If driving on a surface with poor traction, a driver should accelerate slowly:

options.text: Because it is always good to accelerate slowly.
To keep from losing control of the vehicle.
So that they do not accelerate faster than the vehicle ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: To keep from losing control of the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Accelerate slowly on surfaces with poor traction, such as rain or snow, to avoid losing control of the vehicle.

questions.question: If your vehicle gets stuck on railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Sit in the cab and call for help.
Exit the cab and walk away from the tracks.
Motion for another driver to push your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Exit the cab and walk away from the tracks.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle gets stuck on railroad tracks, exit the vehicle immediately and walk away from the tracks. Then call emergency authorities.

questions.question: An indicator that cargo contains hazardous materials is:

options.text: The cargo is stored in cylinder tanks.
The cargo is picked up from a supermarket.
The cargo is packaged in cardboard boxes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cargo is stored in cylinder tanks.
questions.explanation: Cylinders and drums are often used to transport hazardous materials. The type of packaging can tell you if cargo is hazardous.

questions.question: Backing with a trailer is dangerous because:

options.text: It is difficult to see behind the vehicle.
Most trucks do not have the ability to move in reverse.
Cargo may fall out of the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is difficult to see behind the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Backing a truck is dangerous because you cannot see everything behind the vehicle. Avoid backing whenever possible.

questions.question: When a tank divided by bulkheads is being loaded with liquid cargo, most of the weight should be placed:

options.text: In the top of the tank.
In the middle of the tank.
In the rear of the tank.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the middle of the tank.
questions.explanation: Place most of the weight in the middle of the tank. Do not put too much weight on the front or rear of the vehicle.

questions.question: To prevent a vehicle from rolling backward when starting to move forward from a stop, you should:

options.text: Turn off the engine.
Partly engage the clutch.
Apply the emergency brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Partly engage the clutch.
questions.explanation: On a vehicle with manual transmission, partly engage the clutch before removing your foot from the brake pedal. This prevents the vehicle from rolling backward.

questions.question: What does an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) do?

options.text: It allows a vehicle's wheels to lock up.
It prevents a vehicle's wheels from locking up.
It makes turning a vehicle easier.

questions.correctAnswerText: It prevents a vehicle's wheels from locking up.
questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents wheel lockup during hard braking. It reduces braking pressure to a safe level when lockup is about to happen.

questions.question: When using a fire extinguisher on a fire, you should:

options.text: Get as close to the fire as possible.
Stand as far away from the fire as possible.
Aim the extinguisher at the top of the fire.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stand as far away from the fire as possible.
questions.explanation: Stand as far away from the fire as possible. Aim at the base of the fire, not the flames. If you are unsure which extinguisher to use, especially for a hazardous materials fire, wait for firefighters.

questions.question: The service air line is often controlled by the foot brake and is attached to the ____ valves.

options.text: Relay
Supply
Emergency

questions.correctAnswerText: Relay
questions.explanation: The service air line is controlled by the foot brake or trailer hand brake. It is attached to relay valves, which apply the trailer brakes quickly.

questions.question: Looking at the road ahead:

options.text: Is more dangerous than only watching your mirrors.
Does not help you drive safely.
Helps you avoid sudden lane changes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Helps you avoid sudden lane changes.
questions.explanation: Sudden lane changes are dangerous when driving a large vehicle. Looking ahead helps you see obstacles early. This lets you plan ahead and avoid needing to make sudden lane changes.

questions.question: Regrooved tires are:

options.text: Allowed only on the front of a bus.
Allowed only on the rear of a bus.
Not allowed anywhere on a bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allowed only on the rear of a bus.
questions.explanation: Regrooved, recapped, or retreaded tires cannot be used on the front of a bus. They are only allowed on the rear.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is safe to drive with one or two missing lug nuts.
A cracked lock ring is safe if you drive slower than 55 mph.
A missing clamp on a rim is dangerous and must be fixed.

questions.correctAnswerText: A missing clamp on a rim is dangerous and must be fixed.
questions.explanation: Missing clamps, spacers, studs, or lugs are dangerous. Mismatched, bent, or cracked lock rings are also dangerous. Check that your tires and rims are in good condition before driving your vehicle.

questions.question: When filling a tank divided by bulkheads, most weight should go in the:

options.text: Front of the tank.
Middle of the tank.
Rear of the tank.

questions.correctAnswerText: Middle of the tank.
questions.explanation: When filling a tank divided by bulkheads, weight distribution matters. Do not put too much weight at the front or rear of the tank.

questions.question: If the trailer spring brakes do not release when you push the tractor air supply control, you should:

options.text: Check the air line connections.
Turn on the Anti-Lock Braking System.
Turn the engine off and on again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check the air line connections.
questions.explanation: All vehicle equipment must work properly before you drive. If the trailer spring brakes do not release, make sure the air line connections are tight and sealed properly.

questions.question: A posted ramp speed limit:

options.text: Is safe for all vehicles.
May be too fast for large commercial vehicles.
Is just a suggestion and can be exceeded.

questions.correctAnswerText: May be too fast for large commercial vehicles.
questions.explanation: Speed limits on ramps are set for regular cars. Large or loaded commercial vehicles need to go slower than the posted limit. Drivers should reduce speed as needed.

questions.question: If your brakes fail going downhill and there is no escape ramp, you should:

options.text: Keep pumping the brakes.
Turn off the engine.
Drive into an open field.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive into an open field.
questions.explanation: If brakes fail going downhill, first look for an escape ramp. If no ramp is available, find another safe place to stop, such as an open field or side road that is flat or goes uphill.

questions.question: To prevent drowsiness while driving, you should:

options.text: Drive alone.
Avoid regular exercise.
Get enough sleep before the trip.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get enough sleep before the trip.
questions.explanation: Driving while tired is very dangerous. Get a full night of sleep before your trip. You can also have someone ride with you, schedule trips when you are normally awake, and avoid medicines that cause drowsiness. Exercise regularly to have more energy.

questions.question: What does a shipping paper describe?

options.text: The materials being transported
How the materials will be transported
Who should receive the materials being transported

questions.correctAnswerText: The materials being transported
questions.explanation: Shipping papers must include a description of the specific hazardous materials being transported, along with other required information.

questions.question: Mirrors should be:

options.text: Checked only when changing lanes.
Checked often.
Checked only if you suspect a problem.

questions.correctAnswerText: Checked often.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors regularly while driving. This helps you stay aware of traffic and watch for problems on your own vehicle.
